name: DNS routing change to Teams Adaptive Card (Preview)
description:
## What it does

Receives a dns-probe routing-change callback and renders the previous and current IP/routing, domain, environment, and detection time as an Adaptive Card using **Webhook → Code → DevX Message Connector**.

## Setup

1. Add a **DevX Message Connector** credential containing the full Teams channel link and configure `DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_URL` and `DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_KEY`.
2. While editing, POST the documented sample payload to `/webhook-test/devx/dns-routing-change` and inspect the Preview response.
3. Activate the workflow and set the dns-probe `ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL` to `/webhook/devx/dns-routing-change`. Change **Mode** to **Send** only after reviewing the card.

## Notes

The probe sends notifications only when routing changes. Preview calls `<DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_URL>/api/v1/messages/preview` without posting to Teams; it is not an offline transformation mode. The Webhook responds immediately, so acceptance does not confirm Teams delivery. The Code node is the exact script from the [source runbook](https://bcgov.github.io/common-hosted-workflow/platform/dns-probe). No credentials or pinned execution data are included.
